title: Qwen thinking lab
description: Explore Qwen's thinking controls while keeping final-answer quality separate from trace length.
lesson: The source uses think-tag parsing over a stream. Modern Ollama can return native thinking and content fields; the learning transport accepts both forms while keeping traces out of subsequent answer history.
experiment: Use a fixed set of exact-answer tasks with thinking enabled and disabled where supported. Record correctness, first-token time, completion time and token usage rather than judging a longer trace as better.
starter: A train travels 84 km in 70 minutes at a constant speed. What is its speed in kilometres per hour? State the final number and unit.
pitfall: Thinking modes are model/version capabilities. An unsupported option is an integration error, not evidence that the model cannot solve the task.
